sentence.text: European cement carries €75.46 per tonne of cost from CBAM certificates on the importer, and its binding constraint is the green premium against willingness to pay.

why_it_matters.text: The largest gap the sector's own numbers state is 75-150% above a conventional plant. 8 projects are building against it, 4 at or past a final investment decision, and the most recent move was Slite CCS to paused on 19 November 2025.

facts.text: Green premium against willingness to pay — a market constraint, acted on by 4 ranked measures at 3 of combined weight.
